title: Steamed Broccoli with Spicy Malaysian Sauce
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired side dish, featuring steamed broccoli smothered in a spicy Malaysian sauce.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine Japanese-style rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, grated ginger, and minced garlic.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Meanwhile, steam the broccoli florets in a steamer basket until tender but still crisp.
In a large bowl, toss the steamed broccoli with the spicy Malaysian sauce until well coated.
Serve the broccoli immediately, garnished with chopped green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
